land or wasteland.

undertake the project; 
(b)  financial capacity; and

of fifteen years subject to satisfactory performance by the applicant.

other than the permitted or permissible use under the Agreement, this 
Act or the rules; and

incidents such as forest fire, insect attack and diseases.
